commands.name: plan
commands.summary: Preview registration changes; never writes to Dataverse.

options.name: --package
options.description: A built plugin package (repeatable).

options.name: --packages-dir
options.description: Every .nupkg in a folder (the newest version of each package id).

options.name: --package-assembly
options.description: The primary assembly inside the package(s), when it cannot be inferred.

options.name: --solution
options.description: Required (prompted for with --interactive). Target solution: writes and components not yet in it are added to it; also resolves the publisher prefix.

options.name: --webresources
options.description: (preview) Mirror a web resources folder.

options.name: --secure-config
options.description: Value of a step's named secure configuration (repeatable); or VELA_SECURE_CONFIG_<NAME>.

options.name: --managed-identity
options.description: Link the published plugin package(s) to this managedidentity record of the environment; without it the link is left untouched.

options.name: --environment
options.description: Label shown in the output (defaults to --url).

options.name: --out
options.description: Write the JSON document to a file instead of stdout.

options.name: --json
options.description: Machine-readable output on stdout (see docs/reference/machine-readable-output.md).

options.name: --verbose
options.description: More detail on stderr (and full stack traces on failure); never changes stdout.

options.name: --strict
options.description: Fail (exit 4) when there is any warning in diagnostics. Info notices never fail.

options.name: --detailed-exitcode
options.description: Exit 8 when the plan has changes to apply, 0 when there is nothing to do.

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Browser (MSAL) login; the token is cached under ~/.vela so repeat runs are silent.

options.name: --url
options.description: Environment URL. Alone, uses your ambient Azure credential (az login / managed identity).

options.name: --tenant-id
options.description: Tenant for client-secret auth.

options.name: --client-id
options.description: App registration for client-secret auth.

options.name: --client-secret
options.description: Client secret (warned: it leaks to shell history; prefer the two below).

options.name: --client-secret-stdin
options.description: Read the client secret from piped stdin (or set DATAVERSE_CLIENT_SECRET).

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: Full Dataverse connection string (or DATAVERSE_CONNECTION_STRING).

options.name: --auth-client-id
options.description: MSAL public client id for --interactive.

options.name: --authority
options.description: MSAL authority (sovereign clouds).

options.name: --fresh-login
options.description: Forget the cached interactive account and prompt again.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Dataverse connection timeout (1-60, default 10).

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help.
